ba_top100_hist.access: Internet Archive Wayback Machine copies of baseballamerica.com pages (all-time Top 100 index, capture 2017-07-06; the dated year pages for each list's dateline); Python fetch, 1.5 s between requests
ba_top100_hist.terms: Baseball America content is copyrighted (baseballamerica.com terms of use: personal, non-commercial use). The pages were free to read without a login when captured. The Internet Archive serves its copies for research. Only list facts are stored; raw captures stay in the gitignored cache. Not a licence to republish.
ba_top100_hist.grade_field: rank only (no FV, no letter grade)

ba_org10_hist.list: organization Top 10 Prospects (offseason, one team per page)
ba_org10_hist.access: Internet Archive Wayback Machine copies of baseballamerica.com organization-top-10-prospects pages, 2007 to 2013 folders

bp_top100_hist.access: baseballprospectus.com/news/article/<id>/ (articles marked 'This is a free article'); robots.txt allows the path, Crawl-delay 2
bp_top100_hist.terms: Baseball Prospectus terms and conditions: personal, non-commercial use. Free articles, no login. Only list facts are stored.

sickels_hist.publisher: John Sickels, Minor League Ball (SB Nation)
sickels_hist.list: organization Top 20 Prospects with letter grades
sickels_hist.access: Internet Archive Wayback Machine copies of minorleagueball.com posts (the live site refuses scripted connections); posts by John Sickels only, community FanPosts and the hypothetical 'shadow' lists excluded
sickels_hist.terms: Vox Media terms of use: personal, non-commercial use. Public posts, no login. Only list facts and the printed letter grade are stored.
sickels_hist.grade_field: rank within organization and a letter grade (A to C-), printed as 'extremely preliminary' by the author

mlbcom_top50_hist.access: Wayback copies of mlb.mlb.com/mlb/minorleagues/prospects/y2009/ and the open data-graph.mlb.com GraphQL host (slugs sel-pr-2009-top100 and sel-pr-2010-top100 return 50 rows each; 2005 to 2008 return none)
mlbcom_top50_hist.terms: MLB Advanced Media terms of use; public pages.
mlbcom_top50_hist.not_ingested: 2009 list announced on mlb.mlb.com/mlb/minorleagues/prospects/y2009/ with 'Prospects 1 to 10 coming December 5th' (capture 2008-12-05): published in December 2008, outside the 2009 window. 2010 list (50 rows on the GraphQL host) has no publisher-dated page reachable without a block (mlb.com returned 406) and no archive capture; a third-party report dates it 2010-01-28, which the registration does not admit. 2004 to 2008 lists sit on an all-time page first captured 2008-12-05, outside every window.

fg_hulet_hist.terms: FanGraphs terms of use; free articles.
fg_hulet_hist.not_ingested: not probed inside the time box: WebFetch-only access, and the organization lists were published October to February, so most fall before their window
